stepTitle: Capturing Two Words After a Word Containing "love"
stepBody: Samantha wants to understand what users love about her videos. To do this, she decides to write a regex pattern that will capture the next two words that appear after any word containing “love” in a comment. Select the regex pattern below that will achieve this goal. The correct answer should satisfy the test cases above when the regex pattern is assigned to the variable pattern.##figure1.gif##
